### export_customer

_table_ · [init.sql](../../testdb/init.sql#L101)

Dedicated to ExportTreeRegressionTests (nested export records assembled in C# from plain rows). Read-only for every test. Covers, in one small graph: several root rows, a 1:1 lookup (order → customer) including a shared parent (orders 100 and 101 → customer 1) and a NULL foreign key (order 102 → no customer), a 1:n relation (order → lines) including an order with none (101), a second nesting level (line → tags) including a line with none (1001), and NULL values in otherwise-populated columns.
